notes.title: One Month of Stellar Plans – From the Heart, Thank You
notes.notes:
It’s hard to believe, but Stellar Plans has already been out for nearly a month. I want to sincerely thank everyone who’s played and supported the game.

I know the game isn’t perfect—right now, it’s probably a 3-star experience. And I’m fully aware of its flaws.

The journey didn’t begin on March 7th—back on July 17th last year, I released version 1.0 of the PC version on Steam. My goal was to gather feedback and improve the game’s quality. I also hoped it might generate enough income to bring on artists, animators, and others to help grow the project. Unfortunately, it earned very little money.

But I didn’t give up. I spent six more months working entirely solo—optimizing the PCVR version, adding new features, weapons, and maps—and finally completed the Meta Quest version. On March 7th, I launched version 2.0.

To everyone who purchased the game: thank you. I truly hope it was because you connected with the game’s concept and content—not just to support an indie developer. That kind of recognition means everything to me.

Let me share a little more about the game’s concept:
You'll travel between two worlds—one belonging to humanity, and another, a wild land of native magical beasts. There’s no clear line between good and evil here. You’ll even step into the shoes of your enemies, battling former allies from a different point of view.

Master a wide range of weapons and evolving abilities—from futuristic rifles and pistols to swords and axes—and pilot powerful mechs in both aerial and ground combat.

Customize your character’s stats, talents, and gear. Interact with over 30 NPCs, complete achievements, and unlock powerful abilities like “Flame Enchant,” which sets your weapons ablaze for continuous damage.

Uncover the secrets behind the Stellar Plans and the mysterious sky city, while fighting against human forces, mech armies, dragons, and terrifying alien mutants.

This project is still growing, and I’m here—always listening. As long as there’s feedback, I’ll keep improving it.

You can always reach me or follow development on:
📌 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/yhC7CmXQqQ
📌 Twitter / X: https://x.com/StellarPlansVR
📌 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@StellarPlans
📌 Email: stellarplansvr@gmail.com
📌 Linktree: https://linktr.ee/StellarPlans

Feel free to reach out anytime—I truly welcome all feedback and conversations.
Thank you again for being part of this journey.

notes.title: Steam Version Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for playing our game! Based on the feedback we’ve gathered from the community, we’re rolling out a new update to enhance your gaming experience. Here’s what’s new in this version:

1.Mission Progress Tracking
We’ve noticed that many players are unsure whether they’ve completed a mission before leaving the level. To address this, we’ve added a Mission Tab in the game settings. Now, when you press the settings button during a mission, you’ll find a new mission section located below the Talents menu. This will allow you to check your progress at any time.

2.Improved Early Game Tutorial
Some players found the early game experience a bit confusing. To make it more beginner-friendly, we have enhanced the tutorial system with more targeted guidance, ensuring a smoother introduction to the game.

3.Grabbing Optimization
We’ve expanded the interaction detection area for grabbing weapons, attachments, ammo, and equipment. This should make it easier to pick up items—hopefully without introducing any unexpected issues!

4.Expanded Tutorial & Guidance for the Second World
The tutorial and guidance for the second world have been further improved, making it more detailed and intuitive.

5.Enemy Balance Adjustments
          Early-game archer AI has been nerfed to make the initial stages more balanced.
          Enemies in later stages now deal increased damage. This difficulty scaling is based on whether the Second World has been activated.

6.Weapon & Equipment Placement Adjustments
Some weapons and equipment were placed in awkward or illogical positions. We’ve made improvements to item placements across the maps, ensuring more reasonable and strategic locations for weapon and gear spawns.

Thank you for your continued support! We hope you enjoy the latest update, and we look forward to your feedback.

notes.title: The StellarPlans 2.0 update is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Great news, Steam players! The StellarPlans 2.0 update is now live on Steam, bringing a massive upgrade to your PC VR experience!

Back on July 17th, we launched the Steam version, which we called 1.0, focused primarily on shooting. 

Now, with 2.0, we’ve taken it far beyond that. This update introduces bows, arrows, and melee weapons, adding depth and variety to the gameplay. 

Plus, you’ll face 6 epic bosses ready to test your skills. Compared to 1.0, we’ve revamped the experience with improved tutorials, clearer path guidance, new maps, talents, and so much more. Priced at just $7, this reflects my commitment to delivering on my original vision.

Sorry for keeping you waiting—we’ve also squashed a ton of quirky bugs! 

Since we optimized the mission paths for 2.0, we gathered suggestions from everyone on Discord and decided to reset game progress.

But don’t worry, 2.0 now includes achievements, so you can unlock some exciting rewards as you play. 

The Steam version harnesses your PC’s power for stunning graphics and top-tier performance—perfect for VR enthusiasts who crave the ultimate adventure. 

Oh, and by the way, we’re also prepping a Meta Quest version for March 7th at 10 AM Pacific Time, but the real star today is Steam 2.0. 

Download it now and dive in—happy gaming, everyone!

https://discord.gg/yhC7CmXQqQ

notes.title: StellarPlans Developer Announcement 🎃
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and Happy Halloween! 🎃 As the creator of StellarPlans, I want to take this opportunity to thank each of you for your support and let you know that if you enjoy StellarPlans, please consider adding it to your wishlist. It makes a huge difference and keeps us motivated! Thank you all!

Now, here’s a bit of an update on the development progress for version 2.0, which I’ve been working diligently to bring to life. I’d like to explain why it’s been a while since our last content update:

1.Currently, we haven't received significant new feedback.

2.Since I’m building version 2.0 directly on the 1.0 foundation, rushing updates could lead to unexpected bugs, which is why we’re planning a comprehensive major update rather than incremental releases.

3.Most importantly, our goal is for version 2.0 to deliver a polished, immersive, and exciting experience that meets our high-quality standards.

While I would have loved to release a special Halloween version, limited resources and the fact that I'm currently developing this game alone have led me to focus entirely on making version 2.0 the best it can be.

Here’s an early look at some exciting features you can expect in version 2.0:

1.New human base battle map
2.Expanded dragon habitat
3.Enhanced melee weaponry
4.New firearms
5.Independent mech talent system
6.New skill talents
7.New humanoid Boss
8.New dragon AI and Boss
9.Updated story progression routes
10.Optimized map performance

The tentative release date for version 2.0 is January 10, 2025 (subject to change as we refine the game).

Thank you all for your incredible patience and support! I’m always reachable on Discord and X (Twitter), so feel free to drop by and share your thoughts.

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.notes:
Due to the recent decrease in feedback, we are optimizing the map and preparing for version 2.0. From now on, regular updates will be changed to every two weeks or monthly. During this period, we are fully focusing on the development of StellarPlans 2.0. Here’s a sneak peek at the content of version 2.0: two brand-new maps, new talents, weapons, bows, and melee weapons will all be available, along with an improved mech system that includes a development feature.

This update:

1.We are optimizing maps, so the early tutorial levels, the rescue mission levels, and the Black Abyss will all be updated for a smoother experience.

2.Based on player feedback, the hit response was not obvious enough, only showing a blood overlay, which led to higher death rates. We’ve decided to scale back some hit reactions—players will now experience a slight knockback when hit (as opposed to the large knockback in previous versions).

Thank you for playing, and stay tuned for version 2.0!

notes.title: Regular Update | We Welcome Your Feedback
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continued support! Based on your feedback, we’ve made the following updates:

1.Weapon Balance
We've noticed that many players are using pistols, so we've decided to increase their damage:
Black Pistol: Damage 20 -> 30
Green Pistol: Damage 40 -> 50
Red Pistol: Damage 70 -> 80
Black Automatic Pistol: Damage 30 -> 40
Green Automatic Pistol: Damage 50 -> 60
Red Automatic Pistol: Damage 80 -> 90

2.Rescue Teammate Mission Adjustments
We noticed that the number of early enemies in the rescue teammate mission was slightly high, and the enemies that appear when reuniting with the captured teammate were a bit too strong. We have adjusted the number of early enemies and reduced the number of enemies at the end of the mission.

3.Pistol Reload Magnetism Adjustment
We have adjusted the magnetism distance for reloading pistols, so players can now reload from a more comfortable distance.

4.Beast Region Equipment Buff
We noticed that the Beast Region has lower player engagement, so we decided to strengthen the equipment in this area:
Moon Silver Gauntlets: Vitality 2, Power 2, Health Regen Rate 1 -> Vitality 2, Power 3, Health Regen Rate 1
Ashen Iron Greaves: Health +5, Power +5 -> Health +6, Power +5
Grogan Bloodclaw's Relic: Health Regen Rate +1, Health +10, Power +10 -> Health Regen Rate +2, Health +10, Power +10

Please continue to provide feedback and share your gaming experience with us. We will keep optimizing the game based on your input!

notes.title: StellarPlans Regular Update
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you all for your valuable feedback and continued support! We have been closely listening to your suggestions and have made several adjustments based on your input. Here are the updates for this week:

1.Index Controller Grip Adjustment
We understand that some players using Index controllers have experienced issues with weapons slipping out of their hands. We have adjusted the finger threshold presets for Index controllers. Additionally, you can configure your Index controllers yourself through the SteamVR platform by pressing the menu button on the right-hand controller to activate the configuration settings.

2.Pistol Magazine Ejection Force
We have received feedback that some devices make it too easy to eject the pistol magazine. We have increased the physical force required to eject the pistol magazine. Considering that rifles are gripped at the handguard and won't have accidental ejections, we have reduced the ejection force for rifles to allow for quick magazine changes during combat, while pistols now require more deliberate effort to eject the magazine.

3.Increased Maximum Turn Speed
Some players requested a higher maximum turn speed. We have increased the maximum turn speed from 180 to 270 degrees to accommodate this preference.

4.Default Movement Speed Increase
We noticed that some players wanted a faster default movement speed. We have increased both the default movement speed and sprint speed. To sprint, press and hold the forward thumbstick, and after initiating the sprint, releasing it will maintain the sprint.

5.Early-Game AI Health Adjustment
To help players better enjoy the early stages and experience the exciting content later in the game, we have further reduced the health of early-game AI enemies.

6.Rescue Teammate Mission Graphic Adjustments
We have addressed graphical inconsistencies in the rescue teammate mission. Now, when enemies are hit, their blood will no longer float above them.

Please continue to follow our update announcements. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we are committed to improving your gaming experience. Thank you for your support and understanding!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: StellarPlans Regular Update

1.Adjusted Pistol Grip Position
Thanks to your feedback, we have adjusted the pistol grip position to better match the natural grip of human hands.

2.Modified Restart Game Description
The "Restart Game" description has been changed to "Reset Game Progress and Delete Game Data," with an added clarification screen.

3.Removed Choice Between Sky City and Human War
Players will first engage in the Human War, ensuring they are stronger when entering Sky City for a better game rhythm and more comfortable experience.

4.Increased Drop Zone for Weapons and Equipment
We have increased the drop zone for weapons and equipment, making it easier for players to equip their gear.

5.Increased Menu Font Size
The menu font size has been increased, and the color depth has been adjusted to enhance the player's menu experience.

6.Updated Camp Return Explanation
The "Return to Camp" function is now explained as a solution for game freezes.

7.Adjusted Beast Area Boss Health
We have adjusted the health and damage of the Beast Area Boss: increased the health and decreased the damage in the first phase, and decreased the health and increased the damage in the second phase. This allows players to better clear surrounding minions in the first phase and focus on the Boss in the second phase.

8.Final Human War
Based on comprehensive feedback, we decided not to weaken the enemies. Instead, we increased the player's weapon range, allowing for safer distance attacks.

Please continue to follow our update announcements. Your feedback is very important to us. Thank you for your support and understanding!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: StellarPlans Regular Update
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for StellarPlans! We have been actively listening to your feedback and are committed to continuously improving the game experience. Here are the details of the latest update:

1. New Auto-Reload Feature
In response to popular demand, we have added an auto-reload feature. Now, by pressing the X button on the left controller, you can quickly drop the magazine. The X button on the left controller now has two functions:

Press to quickly drop the magazine;
Teleport to another world.
For those who are more accustomed to manually removing the magazine, don’t worry—we have kept the physical magazine removal operation intact.

Please note that in mission levels, pressing the X button will only drop the magazine quickly and will not trigger the teleportation function.

2. Reduced Early Dungeon Difficulty
To help new players adapt more smoothly to the game's pace, we have made adjustments to the difficulty of the early dungeon levels:

Leopard Archers: Health decreased by 10, damage decreased by 5, and battle merit drop increased by 5.
Bear Warriors: Damage decreased by 5.
Elephant Warriors: Health decreased by 10, damage decreased by 5, and battle merit drop increased by 5.
Reduced the difficulty of the "Rescue Teammates" mission, decreasing the number of monsters blocking the door in the early stages.
These adjustments will help players progress through the early stages more quickly and accumulate more battle merits for exchanging items in the shop.

3. Increased Player Base Health Bonus
We have increased the base health bonus for players. Now, each point of the Health attribute will increase Blood by 12 points, allowing players to better complete missions.

4. Optimized Mission Levels for Stable Frame Rate
We have further optimized mission levels to enhance overall game performance, ensuring a more stable frame rate and smoother gameplay.

5. Weapon and Item Damage Balancing
To maintain game balance and challenge, we have adjusted the damage of certain weapons and items:

Red - Legendary: Damage increased by 5.
Blue - Epic: Damage decreased by 5.
Green - Good: Damage increased by 5.
6. Removed Some Texture Effects
We have removed some texture effects to lighten the load on mission levels and improve game performance.

7. Fixed JackMax's Mission Dialogues
We have fixed errors in JackMax's mission dialogues, ensuring a more cohesive and immersive storyline.

We will continue to work hard to provide you with a better gaming experience. Thank you for your valuable feedback and support! We look forward to more exciting adventures with you in StellarPlans!

Best regards,
StellarPlans Development Team

notes.title: Regular Update

1.Fixed UI Menu Double Text Effect
We have fixed the issue where the UI menu displayed double text (often reported as a shadowing issue). Thank you for your feedback.

2.Added Mid-Mission Save Mechanism
Except for the final battle of humanity, there is now a save mechanism in the middle of mission maps to make the game more convenient.

3.Weapon Stuck in Wall Issue
Due to the collision between weapons and walls causing them to get stuck, we have tried various solutions. After understanding that the issue mostly occurs in dungeons, we decided to add doors at the entrance of ladders in dungeons, providing a buffer time for players and monsters.

4.Pistol Weapon Twisting Issue
We are still investigating the cause of the pistol weapon twisting during use and will continue to work on it.
Please continue to follow our update announcements. Your feedback is very important to us. Thank you for your support and understanding!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: StellarPlans 1.0 is about to launch!
notes.notes:
This is a VR shooting and adventure game that takes you into a fantastical world filled with humanoids, beasts, mechanical creatures, and aliens. In this world, there is no boundary between good and evil. You will experience two worlds, follow quests and the stories of 30+ NPCs, explore maps, acquire weapons, learn talent skills, survive in this world, and uncover the secrets of StellarPlans and the Sky City.

I skipped Early Access (EA) because this is the best state of the game right now. Besides regular updates, we will have major updates with versions 1.0, 2.0, 3.0. This is a long-term plan, and this is just the beginning.

Thank you all for your support and love!

notes.title: StellarPlans 1.0 will be launched on time on July 17
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am StellarPlans, an independent game developer. I don't have a team, fancy images, or promotional videos, but I have been tirelessly testing, tweaking, and improving the game experience to bring you the best gameplay possible.

I decided to skip Early Access (EA) and will be using a 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 versioning system for regular updates and improvements. The 1.0 version will feature two world role-playing experiences, over 30 NPCs, numerous quests in both human and beast regions, more than 20 weapons, and over 50 talent skills for you to explore and enjoy.

I have poured an immense amount of time and effort into this game. From writing the code to fine-tuning the details, every step has been done by myself. Nothing would make me happier than seeing you enjoy this game.

On July 17th, my game will be released on time. I can't wait to share it with you, and I look forward to hearing your feedback and opinions. Thank you all for your continuous support and patience. I hope you will love this game.

Stay tuned!

Dear Adventurers,

We've recently received a lot of valuable feedback from players, and we'd like to thank everyone for their support and attention to "Stellar Plans"! In order to enhance the gaming experience, we've made some adjustments and are preparing to release a small patch. Here's what's new:

1.New Human Area - Illusory Arena: In the Illusory Arena, players can experience the thrill and challenge of battling virtual opponents. Check out the Illusory Arena leaderboard to showcase your skills!
2.Optimized Dialogue Box Height: We've noticed that some players have found the dialogue box position too low, making it inconvenient. We've optimized the height of the dialogue box to better fit the screen, allowing you to see the dialogue content more clearly.
3.Added Button Selection Feature: To improve the experience of nodding and shaking heads, we've added the option to press the trigger button to agree and the grip button to disagree. Of course, nodding and shaking heads are still available for players who prefer them.
4.Beast Drop Equipment Optimization: The probability of beasts dropping equipment and merits has been increased, providing richer rewards and challenges for your adventures.
5.Human Drop Attributes Increase: At the same time, we've increased the probability of humans dropping attributes, making it easier for you to obtain useful items and equipment during battles.
6.Dungeon Level Combat Experience Optimization: We've optimized the combat experience in dungeon levels, providing smoother and more thrilling battles during your exploration.
7.Human Battle Area Combat Experience Optimization: Combat experience in the human battle area has been improved, offering richer and more exciting battle content.
8.Oliver Hawkins Questline Reset: Oliver Hawkins will now enter the Illusory Arena, bringing players new tasks and challenges. The questline will inform players about the weapons in nearby chests and also that weapons can be placed on both shoulders.
9.Virtual Human Drop Equipment and Attributes: Virtual humans now also drop equipment and attributes, adding more surprises and possibilities to your adventure.
We hope this small patch will bring you a more enjoyable and fulfilling gaming experience! If you have any comments or suggestions, please feel free to contact us. We are always eager to hear your feedback.

Wishing you a wonderful adventure in "Stellar Plans"!

The "Stellar Plans" Development Team

notes.title: "Stellar Plans" Weekly Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear adventurers,

Thank you for your support and feedback on "Stellar Plans"! We have been listening to your suggestions and have decided to roll out small updates every Wednesday to enhance the gaming experience and address known issues.

In this week's update, we are committed to meeting your expectations and have made the following improvements:

Update Highlights:

Fixed the physics issue with drawing bows and arrows, allowing for smoother archery gameplay.
Resolved the physics problem with large ammo crates, ensuring proper interaction with the game world.
Fixed weapons floating in mid-air, ensuring they are correctly placed next to the character.
Players can now long-press the trigger button on the controller to quickly skip through dialogues. Please note that choice prompts cannot be skipped.
Added a game help feature to the game menu, providing better understanding of game mechanics and controls.
Optimized the pacing of dungeon battles for a more fluid and exciting experience.
Addressed the issue of duplicate starting talents, ensuring players receive unique and correct talents.
Introduced equipment drops in human and beast areas, offering more possibilities for your adventure.
Improved the end-of-demo notification for a smoother transition.
Continuous Improvement:

We will continue to listen to your feedback and strive to make "Stellar Plans" the ultimate fantasy adventure in your eyes! If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.

May you enjoy your journey through the fantastical realms!

The "Stellar Plans" Development Team
